items.stem: Which agent action most clearly warrants a human approval gate?

options.text: An irreversible, high-impact action such as deleting production data
options.rationale: Correct: irreversible high-impact actions are the prime candidates for approval.
Low-risk reversible reads do not need approval.

options.text: Formatting its own output as a list

options.rationale: An internal, harmless computation needs no gate.

items.explanation: Correct: irreversible high-impact actions are the prime candidates for approval.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO make an approval request easy to review well? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A concise summary of what will happen and why
options.rationale: Correct: the approver needs the intent and impact at a glance.

options.text: The exact action and its parameters that will execute
options.rationale: Correct: showing the precise action lets the approver verify it.

options.text: A request with no detail, just an Approve button
options.rationale: Without detail the approval is meaningless.

options.text: A 50-page raw log dump with no summary
options.rationale: An unstructured dump hides the decision the approver must make.

items.explanation: Correct: the approver needs the intent and impact at a glance.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: An approval request times out with no response. What is the safe default?

options.text: Do not perform the action; hold or cancel and escalate
options.rationale: Correct: a timeout should fail safe to no action, not proceed.

options.text: Automatically approve and run the action
options.rationale: Auto-approving on timeout defeats the oversight.
Blind retries can repeatedly attempt a risky action.

options.text: Delete the pending state and the audit record

items.explanation: Correct: a timeout should fail safe to no action, not proceed.
